description: This repository extracts building-permit information from monthly City of Spearfish, South Dakota PDF summaries. Its README says the archive begins in January 2013, stores month-labelled CSVs and combines them into one building-permits CSV. The public tree lists monthly files through September 2025; that path list does not prove every month is complete or that later city reports are absent. The combine step excludes burn and sign permits. The original city archive page opened, but the PDFs and extracted rows were not inspected. GitHub metadata reports the Unlicense for the repository, and access to the repository is free. The city’s original report rights were not separately determined. Simulation use includes local construction-activity trends or a permit-based proxy for planned building-stock changes, with a lag and completion-rate caveat: a permit does not prove construction happened. It complements data-us-census-building-permits-survey by exposing report-level records for one municipality, not national survey aggregates. Address accuracy, permit valuation units and the extraction error rate require checking against the cited original reports.
